title: The stable branch moves only on a push run that ran its suites, or whose tree a green PR run proved
why: An empty-green push run moved origin/stable to the #3278 merge, which carries the CI break.
source: Consultant via the coordinator 19:46 and 19:47 CST Nov 13; lane plan not yet read by triage. Unchecked: whether the stable mover's checkout always holds merge/ and python.
note: Filed 19:48 CST Nov 13. Facts (consultant): .github/workflows/stable.yml moves origin/stable on any push run with conclusion success, so run 43515441901 (no suites ran) moved stable to ab27336489. Main push run 43540952042 (309fa5ed) was in progress at 19:46; if it ends success with no suites, stable moves again. Scope: stable moves only on a push run that ran its suites, or whose tree a green PR run proved (owner 16:03 a1), through one shared reader. Lane merge-flow-after-anthropic (PR #3297, session_013NEJL2oxYMVKoXseeKacVG) plan, 10 lines, nothing pushed: shared reader suites_proof extracted from Host.base_state; a merge --suites-proved <run id> entry the stable mover calls; tests red on main first. It rests on item 781 cover rule (open). Moving stable back needs a force and is not in the plan. Triage has not read the plan text; coordinator offers to relay it. Lane plan 19:48 CST Nov 13 (merge-flow-after-anthropic, 10 points, nothing pushed, waits on item 781). Read on main: stable.yml moves on any success of checks on a main push; actions/stable-mover/run.sh checks only conclusion success, descent and head on main, never jobs (run 43515441901 had 27 jobs skipped). Plan: (1) extract the skipped-run read in Host.base_state (merge/merge.py) into one function suites_proof(host, run) returning proved, not proved or unknown; base_state calls it. (2) Flag merge --suites-proved <run id>: exit 0, 1, 2. (3) run.sh calls it before the push: refuse on 1, stay on 2; action.yml gets input run-id. (4) Proved = suites ran, or (only if the owner keeps the cover, item 781) a green PR run of the tree that ran suites. (5) Cases first, red on main: test_action.sh and test_merge.py. (6) Builder sonnet, reviewer rounds; net-value test at round 3. (7) Docs: Cost line in no-merge-onto-red-main.md. Measured read-only: stable.yml checks out the head with full depth, so merge.py and its repo imports are present. Unmeasured: system python3 version against merge.py floor (checks pin 3.11); add setup-python to stable.yml. Not in plan: moving stable back from ab27336489 needs a force. Open round 2 findings on #3297 sit with item 781.
